free_tier.stated: TCP redirections are currently available free of charge as long as the feature is in BETA stage. Once the feature leaves the BETA stage, it won't be free anymore.

egress.terms: No free application tier is published; pricing is pay-as-you-go per scaler and add-on. Free plans exist only for storage products (Cellar first 100 MB).; ingress: tcp
egress.free_allowance: No free application tier is published; pricing is pay-as-you-go per scaler and add-on. Free plans exist only for storage products (Cellar first 100 MB).

interface_detail: Console and API; "From your console, select your application".
tooling: Console or CLI; the port is assigned by Clever Cloud.
chaining: With a paid scaler, the redirection is an SSH or database path; no free option.

limits.value: no free application allowance; TCP redirection free only while in beta

binding_note: The redirection is free but the application it points at is not; the free tier fails before any byte is counted.

identity_cost.detail: Pay-as-you-go account with a funded balance; the pricing page says each month you fund your account to reflect your usual consumption.

reliability_note: The feature is labelled BETA and the free status is explicitly temporary. Random port above 5000, so the endpoint is not predictable.
confidence_note: The beta statement is dated 2022 on the blog and unversioned in the docs; re-reading it later is what keeps this record honest.

evidence.proved: TCP redirection to port 4040, external port random above 5000

"It can be used freely and is not charged." (2022-03-29)

notes: The redirection is a genuinely free L4 path, but only to a paid application. The application must still listen on 8080 regardless of TCP configuration.

extras.wg_detail: TCP only: "you can use a TCP redirection to route TCP traffic, through Clever Cloud reverse proxies, to your application." Port is "chosen at random above 5000".

extras.transit_note: Clever Cloud reverse proxies carry the TCP stream.
